  - heading "Senior Game UI & Multimedia Designer" [level=2]
  - paragraph: Full Time 8 days ago

  - button "Save job":
    - img
  - button "Copy link":
    - img

  - heading "Realistic Shooter / Unreal Engine" [level=3]
  - paragraph:
    - text: We are looking for a talented and hands-on
    - strong: Game UI & Multimedia Designer
    - text: to join our team working on a mobile-first realistic shooter built in Unreal Engine 5.
  - paragraph:
    - text: The main focus of this role is creating
    - strong: high-quality, visually impressive UI for a modern realistic shooter
    - text: . You will design everything from HUDs and gameplay interfaces to menus, inventories, loadouts, matchmaking, mission screens and progression systems.
  - paragraph:
    - text: You will work closely with our game designers and Unreal developers, who will bring your designs into the game. You should therefore have a good understanding of
    - strong: Unreal Engine 5 and UMG
    - text: ", but this is primarily a"
    - strong: visual design role
    - text: — we are looking for someone whose strongest skill is creating exceptional game UI, rather than programming or technical implementation.
  - paragraph:
    - text: Alongside game UI, you will also create
    - strong: gameplay clips, trailers, motion graphics and promotional content
    - text: using footage captured from the game.
  - heading "What we are looking for" [level=3]:
    - strong: What we are looking for
  - list:
    - listitem:
      - paragraph:
        - text: Strong professional experience in
        - strong: game UI design
        - text: ", ideally for shooters, action games or realistic games"
    - listitem:
      - paragraph:
        - text: A strong portfolio showing
        - strong: polished, modern HUDs and in-game UI
    - listitem:
      - paragraph:
        - text: Excellent understanding of the visual language used in
        - strong: realistic and military-style games
    - listitem:
      - paragraph: Ability to design complete game interfaces, including HUDs, menus, inventories, loadouts, mission screens, progression systems and other gameplay UI
    - listitem:
      - paragraph: Strong UI/UX fundamentals, combining visual quality with readability and gameplay usability
    - listitem:
      - paragraph:
        - text: Good understanding of
        - strong: Unreal Engine 5 and UMG
        - text: ", with the ability to prepare designs and assets for efficient implementation by our Unreal team"
    - listitem:
      - paragraph:
        - text: Strong knowledge of
        - strong: Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma, After Effects, Premiere
        - text: or equivalent tools
    - listitem:
      - paragraph:
        - text: Ability to create
        - strong: animated UI, motion graphics and UI transitions
    - listitem:
      - paragraph:
        - text: Ability to capture and edit compelling
        - strong: gameplay footage, gameplay clips and trailers
    - listitem:
      - paragraph: Good understanding of cinematic editing, pacing, sound and presentation for game marketing content
    - listitem:
      - paragraph:
        - text: Comfortable using
        - strong: AI tools
        - text: for ideation, design exploration and content creation
    - listitem:
      - paragraph: Strong visual eye and exceptional attention to detail
    - listitem:
      - paragraph: Highly organized and systematic when managing source files, assets, versions and deliverables
  - heading "Most important" [level=3]:
    - strong: Most important
  - paragraph:
    - text: We are looking for someone who can take a gameplay requirement, concept or rough wireframe and transform it into a
    - strong: visually outstanding, production-ready game UI
    - text: .
  - paragraph:
    - text: Your portfolio should show UI that could belong in a
    - strong: high-quality modern shooter
    - text: . We are not primarily looking for candidates whose experience is focused on websites, mobile apps or corporate interfaces.
  - paragraph:
    - strong: "Location:"
    - text: B2B offshore/remote.
  - paragraph:
    - text: If this sounds like you, we would love to see your
    - strong: portfolio and CV
    - text: ", together with your salary expectations. Please send them to"
    - link "hr@ibloxx.com":
      - /url: mailto:hr@ibloxx.com
      - strong: hr@ibloxx.com
